A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DROCO study and include readable methods, equations, experiments, figures, tables, and Appendices A-J. Content can be matched reliably despite reflow and equation renumbering.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E report original MuJoCo/D4RL experiments, including comparisons with baselines, robustness evaluations, ablations, and parameter studies.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E retain these original experimental results. Their retention from v1 does not change their status as original empirical work.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D.2 retain the same RCB operators, ensemble dynamics modeling, dynamic value penalty, Huber loss, and IQL-based policy optimization. Algorithm 1 is unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain the same MuJoCo/D4RL tasks and data qualities, kinematic and morphology shifts, adversarial perturbations, observation/reward shifts, and differing-behavior-policy evaluations. No evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain IQL*, CQL*, BOSA, DARA, IGDF, and OTDF. Perturbation comparisons retain IGDF and OTDF, while Appendix E.6-E.7 retains IQL, IGDF, and OTDF. Added citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Both retain 10% target-data sampling for the main comparisons, one million policy-training steps, D4RL normalized scores, and identical perturbation and corruption protocols. Dataset-size experiments and settings in Appendices C, E, and F are unchanged.

E4.justification: The dynamic-versus-fixed penalty and Huber-versus-squared-loss ablations remain unchanged, as do sensitivity studies of beta, delta, and ensemble size. Appendix E retains the same robustness analyses and dataset-size comparisons.

E5.justification: The five-seed reporting and standard-deviation entries in Tables 1-2 are retained, along with the existing uncertainty displays elsewhere. No repeated-run disclosure, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or statistical test is added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported values and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains totals of 1105.2 for DROCO and 969.8 for OTDF; Table 2 retains 1166.4 and 1025.1, respectively.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, Propositions 4.1-4.6, and Appendix B's proofs retain their mathematical substance. Replacing 'support' with 'supp', editing punctuation, and removing or renumbering equation labels do not revise the reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about cross-domain policy fragility, dual robustness through the RCB operator, and DROCO's empirical advantages. The added code statement does not alter the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Both retain the robustness-performance tradeoff, model-accuracy and overfitting caveats, explanations of perturbation sensitivity, and Appendix A's discussion of Antmaze/Adroit difficulties. No substantive interpretation or applicability boundary changes.

D1.justification: The v2 abstract newly states code availability and supplies a DROCO repository link, absent from v1. Existing implementation instructions, pseudocode, hyperparameters, hardware specifications, and training-time information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6 expands coverage of model-based and in-sample offline RL and adds newer cross-domain and robust-RL references. Section 4 newly credits Liu et al. (2024c) as inspiration. These additions refine attribution and context without redefining the central positioning.

P1.justification: v2 shortens introductory prose, expands the related-work paragraph, and makes grammar and phrasing edits throughout the methods and proofs. It also adds acknowledgements and updates the publication header; the overall narrative structure remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves from page 9 to page 8, text reflows, and captions receive small punctuation or grammar edits. All figure graphics and table structures are retained; the changed pagination does not represent new displays.

improvement.justification: v2 adds previously missing DROCO code-access information and improves literature coverage and attribution, alongside limited editorial polishing. These provide modest documentation benefits; the method, theoretical reasoning, experimental evidence, and limitations remain substantively unchanged.
